newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden reaches five-party central bank accord.
newsitem.headline: Sweden reaches five-party central bank accord.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday five political parties had agreed on legislation for the country's central bank, the Riksbank.
It gave no details about the accord, saying only it would hold a news conference on the issue at 1415 GMT.
"An agreement has been reached between five parties regarding legislation for Sweden's Riksbank," the ministry said in a statement.
"Questions had emerged because of membership in the European Union and a committee responsible for foreign exchange policies," the ministry said.
A government spokesman said the Centre Party, the ruling Social Democrats' informal cooperation partner, was one of the five parties involved in the agreement.
The other parties which had reached the agreement were the Conservatives, the Christian Democrats, Liberal Party and the Social Democrats, the spokesman said.
There are seven parties in the Swedish parliament.
